Five feature families (filesystem, reference_mech, reference_lexical, temporal, status_declared) with per-file-class confinement; per-root sub-scans (infra/org/data/docs primary) each with own charter, model, calibration; W1 review-prep -> Andrew session -> W2 post-review cycle; RULINGS channel for exogenous business context (verbatim, append-only, rendered to machine effects); planted controls + prospective eval + autonomy ladder (ARCHIVE-in-SCRATCH only, MIGRATE/CONTESTED never automated); dedicated rcg/ folder under a manifest-enumerated write gate (imperative: immaculately clean). Denominator at commissioning: 25,273 tracked files.
